text:
ben-support: Heads-up — multiple customer reports in eu-west (mostly eu-west-2) since ~08:30UTC: 502s, long tail timeouts, and elevated retry counts. CS getting billing hits and auth retries too. Customers: B2B-analytics, chatflow, and docsync.

ajay-oncall: Noted. Any correlation with deployments?

ben-support: No deploys in that window. Metrics show gateway 5xx spike starting 08:27 and sustained for ~40m. Latency SLO breaches for short requests too.

tara-sre: Looking at per-AZ graphs — az-b has higher packet loss and RTT variance to our edge. Cross-zone p50 latency jump from 20ms->120ms.

maria-netops: Provider-side alert popped: provider-alert-bot: "Transit ASN 64567 reports BGP route oscillation affecting eu-west edge POPs; some asymmetric paths and packet duplication observed."

ajay-oncall: Can you paste the alert snippet?

provider-alert-bot: "Alert ID: TA-9901. Observed 0.8% packet dup/rewind and intermittent path churn between eu-west backbone and edge-azs. Potential microlooping on provider fabric. Impact: higher TCP retransmits and HTTP 502 from upstream proxies."

tara-sre: Repro steps from customer logs:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood-hosted.eu-west.example/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
> < HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
> < Connection: close
```

ben-support: CS noted some auth failures correlated with retries — looks like token exchange times out when TCP resets happen. Billing system counts retries as extra tokens for a few customers. Need temporary mitigation.

ajay-oncall: Agreed. Immediate mitigation options: 1) enable short client-side retry cap (2 retries max) in gateway config for eu-west, 2) temporarily route traffic from az-b to eu-central fallback pool, 3) throttle large-batch requests to reduce upstream stress.

maria-netops: I'm on provider call. Sending their request to traceback BGP path: asking for timestamps and sample traceroutes. Collecting MTRs from edge nodes and an affected host.

tara-sre: I'll push a config to reduce gateway max_retries to 2 for eu-west; will monitor errors. Also enabling prefilt to drop obvious duplicate segments.

ben-support: CS: please notify affected customers with ETA ~2h and workaround: disable aggressive retry in client-side SDK (set retries=1) and use eu-central regional endpoint while we mitigate.

ajay-oncall: Oncall checklist:
- [x] Confirm no internal deploys
- [x] Reduce gateway retry cap for eu-west (tara)
- [x] Start provider escalation (maria)
- [ ] Consider emergency routing to eu-central if packet loss persists
- [ ] Postmortem owner assign after containment

maria-netops: Provider asked to BGP-communicate a path pin for our edge IPs to avoid flapping ASN for 30m. They're testing now.

provider-alert-bot: "Provider note: Temporary pinning applied to edge prefix 203.0.113.0/24. Monitoring"

tara-sre: After reducing retries we see 5xx rate drop ~60% in the last 10m. Latency tail still high but errors declining.

ben-support: CS reports one customer still seeing billing duplicate tokens during the window — logging a credit action.

ajay-oncall: Good. Keep provider on the line until path stable. Save MTR/traceroute logs to incident doc. I'll own postmortem. Assigning to ajay-oncall for RCA and maria-netops for provider follow-up.

maria-netops: Provider confirms stable after pin. They'll provide BGP dump and TAC ticket ref: TICKET-78321.

tara-sre: We'll keep retry cap for 1h then slowly restore. Watching errors/latency.

ben-support: Thanks all. I'll update CS thread and add credits for affected customers. :thumbsup:

ajay-oncall: Closing active mitigation in 45m unless provider reports new churn. We'll reconvene if errors reappear.

provider-alert-bot: "TICKET-78321: Root cause: transient BGP route churn due to misconfig on transit ASN 64567 interconnect causing packet duplication and asymmetric paths. Mitigation: route pin + provider fix rolling out. Impact window: 08:27-09:20 UTC."
